description: This file defines the EmbeddingManager class for managing text embeddings using the FastEmbed library, including lazy loading, caching, and similarity computations.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: Manages text embeddings with lazy loading, caching, and similarity functions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the EmbeddingManager with a specified model name and lazy model loading.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Property that lazily loads and returns the TextEmbedding model.

methods.name: embed_text
methods.description: Embeds a single text string into a numpy array.

methods.name: embed_batch
methods.description: Embeds a list of texts into a list of numpy arrays efficiently.

methods.name: cosine_similarity
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity between two embedding vectors.

methods.name: batch_cosine_similarity
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity scores between a query vector and multiple document vectors.
